fusions.name: Spore-Laced Jab
fusions.desc: A barbed jab that deals 4 poison damage and leaves spores in the wound: [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Uproot the Bloom
fusions.desc: Tears the growth out of the target, dealing 18 poison damage and using up every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage and 60% more damage for each one used up.

fusions.name: Hyphal Mat
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of threads 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and leaves those it catches [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gets Into Everything
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
